title: El Cántaro de Tonalá, MEXI STORIES
comment: cantaro-tonala (MEXI): patio de una casona de alfareros en Tonalá, Jalisco. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.MARIANA_OCHOA: Mexican woman from Jalisco, 26 years old, light-brown skin, long straight black hair in a low ponytail, small silver earrings, a cream cotton blouse, light-blue jeans, brown flat sandals, her hands empty.
chars.FABIOLA_LEDESMA: Mexican woman, 46 years old, fair skin, short styled auburn hair, red lipstick, pearl earrings, a fitted wine-red dress, a thin gold bracelet, black heels, her hands empty.
chars.REMEDIOS_CANO: Mexican woman, housekeeper of a big family house, 62 years old, brown skin, grey hair in a bun, round glasses, a brown knitted cardigan over a floral blouse, a long grey skirt, flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.ANSELMO_OCHOA: Mexican patriarch from Jalisco, owner of the biggest pottery workshop of Tonalá, 68 years old, tall and broad, light-brown skin, grey hair, a thick grey mustache, a cream panama hat, a white long-sleeve guayabera, grey trousers, a gold ring, brown leather shoes, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_PATIOTONALA: Inner courtyard of a large old family house in Tonalá, Jalisco, in the afternoon: terracotta floor, arches, potted plants, wooden shelves with burnished clay pottery and painted clay water jugs, a stone fountain, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
